name: bondholder-rights-observatory
title: Bondholder Rights & Disclosure Observatory
description: Source-linked, instrument-level records of contractual protections and public disclosures for Indian listed non-convertible debentures. Every field is labelled `brdo:kind`: `identifier`: A key: an ISIN or the id of a record in this dataset.; `source_text`: Verbatim text from a source. Not covered by the dataset's licence, and cut to the source's quotation limit.; `read_from_source`: A fact the source states, transcribed or parsed by the project.; `annotation`: The project's classification or reading. Single-pass; not yet independently reviewed.; `derived`: Computed by code in this repository from other fields.; `provenance`: Where, when and how something was obtained, or the policy governing its use. `brdo:origin` says where a fact originates when that differs from the party that published it. Multi-valued cells are joined with `; `. The sample is selected on reported breaches and describes no market. Absence of a record is never evidence of compliance.

That licence does not cover any field marked `brdo:licensed: false` (kind `source_text`), which holds third-party quotations, nor any source document, none of which is included. See LICENSE-DATA.md.

fields.description: The date the publisher says the file was posted, for example on its listing page. A server's Last-Modified header is never recorded here.

fields.name: published_basis
fields.description: Where the publication date was read.

fields.name: last_modified
fields.description: The server's Last-Modified header for the exact file held. It dates that version on the server. It does not establish first publication: a file can be uploaded before it is linked, replaced later, or copied with a misleading date.
fields.brdo:empty: the server sent no Last-Modified header

fields.name: available_not_before
fields.description: Lower bound: the file cannot have been public before this day, if the dates it prints are right. The latest of its own date, its signature or "as on" date, the start of the period it reports on, the date of a letter in it, and the latest event it records. Before this day the file's state is `not_yet_possible`; from it until `available_confirmed_by`, `uncertain`.
fields.brdo:empty: no lower bound: the record reads no date from the file, so no earlier day is ruled out

fields.name: available_not_before_basis
fields.description: Which kind of date gives the lower bound.

fields.name: available_estimate
fields.description: An estimate, not evidence: the later of the publisher's date and Last-Modified, never before the lower bound. It assumes this exact file was at its address from then; it is not a publication date, and a server's date can precede or follow the file's first appearance. Used only by `--as-of` in the estimated view, where files admitted on it are marked `uncertain` until confirmed.
fields.brdo:empty: neither the publisher nor the server gives a date, so there is no estimate: the estimated view admits the file only from `available_confirmed_by`

fields.name: available_estimate_basis
fields.description: Which date `available_estimate` rests on.

fields.name: available_confirmed_by
fields.description: The day the project retrieved the file from its public address, so it was public by then. The only availability date the record proves, and usually much later than first publication. Used by `--as-of` with `--availability observed`.
fields.brdo:empty: the project never retrieved the file

fields.name: available_window_days
fields.description: Days from the lower bound to the confirmation: the interval within which the file first became public.
fields.brdo:empty: the lower bound or the confirmation is unknown, so the interval is open

fields.name: robots_at_retrieval
fields.description: What the fetcher established about the host's robots policy when it retrieved the file: `obeyed`, `absent` (HTTP 404 or 410) or `unread`, where no policy could be established but an earlier version of the fetcher retrieved the file anyway. The current fetcher would not.
fields.brdo:empty: not recorded for this retrieval

resources.name: attribute-support
resources.description: One row per record that supports an attribute of an instrument or issuer, with the kind of evidence it is and when the record was public. An instrument's `identity` is its ISIN; its `issuer` is which issuer it belongs to, which a record printing the ISIN alone does not show. An issuer's `identity`, `name`, `cin` and `lei` need records that print them for it. Rows with `establishes = false` are kept so that users can see what the record holds, but point-in-time views do not rely on them.

fields.description: The ISIN or the issuer id.

fields.description: `identity` or `issuer` for an instrument; `identity`, `name`, `cin` or `lei` for an issuer.

fields.name: basis

resources.name: breach-notices
resources.description: One row per trustee letter to the holders of an instrument about a breach, or continuing an adjourned meeting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id of the letter record.

fields.name: document
fields.description: Id of the cited file in `documents.csv`.

fields.name: page
fields.description: 1-based page of the file, not the printed page number, on which the item is printed.

fields.name: trustee

fields.name: kind
fields.description: `breach` or `meeting_continuation`.

fields.name: isins
fields.description: ISINs the letter concerns.

fields.name: isins_printed

fields.name: issued_on

fields.name: period_end

fields.name: deed_dates

fields.name: deed_as_reported

fields.name: meeting_proposed_for

fields.name: clause_reference_as_reported
fields.description: Clause reference as printed.

fields.name: covenant_as_reported
fields.description: The covenant passage as printed, cut to the quotation limit.

fields.name: covenant_truncated
fields.description: True when the passage continues beyond the quotation.

fields.name: levels_stated

fields.name: adjourned_for_lack_of_quorum

fields.name: ai_training_reserved

resources.name: notice-report-comparisons
resources.description: One row per ISIN for which a trustee's report row and the same trustee's letter for the same quarter can be compared. Both come from the trustee, so agreement is not independent corroboration.

fields.name: notice
fields.description: Id of the letter in `breach_notices.csv`.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: ISIN of the instrument, validated by its check digit.

fields.name: report
fields.description: Id of the trustee's breach report, a document in `documents.csv`.

fields.name: row
fields.description: Serial number of the report row compared.

fields.name: issuer_intimation_per_notice
fields.description: When the letter says the issuer told it.

fields.name: detected_per_report
fields.description: Detection date the report prints.

fields.name: days_from_intimation_to_detection
fields.description: Detection minus intimation, in days.

fields.name: thresholds_in_notice
fields.description: Levels printed in the letter.

fields.name: thresholds_in_report
fields.description: Levels printed in the report row for the ISIN.

fields.name: thresholds_agree
fields.description: Whether the two sets of numbers match.
fields.brdo:empty: not applicable: the letter prints no level, or only part of its passage was read

fields.name: instruments

fields.name: stated_by

fields.name: scope

fields.name: isins_printed

fields.name: exceptions

fields.name: evidence

resources.name: statement-report-comparisons
resources.description: One row per statement and ISIN, set beside the current trustee report for the same quarter. Agreement shows that the statement was carried into the report, not that it was confirmed.

fields.name: statement
fields.description: Id of the compliance statement in `compliance_statements.csv`.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: ISIN of the instrument, validated by its check digit.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last day of the reporting period the document states it covers.

fields.name: made_by
fields.description: Who made the statement.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: What the statement says it covers.

fields.name: statement_reports_breach
fields.description: True when the statement reports a breach.

fields.name: trustee_report
fields.description: The trustee report compared, if one exists.

fields.name: trustee_lists
fields.description: Whether that report lists the ISIN.
fields.brdo:empty: not comparable: no fully transcribed report of the ISIN's trustee for the period

fields.name: agreement
fields.description: `consistent`, `differs` or `not_comparable`, by rules in docs/data-model.md.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Which rule decided the agreement.

fields.name: levels_only_in_statement
fields.description: Required levels the statement prints and the trustee's report does not print for the ISIN.

fields.name: statement_dated
fields.description: The statement document's own date.

fields.name: trustee_received_report
fields.description: When the trustee records receiving the issuer's quarterly compliance report, from its census table.
fields.brdo:empty: no census of the trustee for the period has been measured, or it has no row cited for the ISIN

fields.name: trustee_detected
fields.description: The trustee's earliest printed detection date for the ISIN.

fields.name: trustee_cites_certificate
fields.description: True when the trustee's row mentions a certificate or auditor (a mechanical text match).

fields.name: trustee_could_rely_on_issuer
fields.description: True when the trustee's detection falls on or after the statement's date or the trustee's receipt of the issuer's report, so the trustee may simply be passing the issuer's information on.

resources.name: field-flows
resources.description: For each agreement between an issuer's statement and a trustee's report on a breach, one row per kind of information, saying which party prints it, with every line, item or letter that satisfied the mechanical rule (docs/methods.md). The 17 agreements come from two issuers; this is not the wider statement comparison in `statement_report_comparisons.csv`, nor the comparison sample's pilot.

fields.name: statement
fields.description: Id of the compliance statement in `compliance_statements.csv`.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: ISIN of the instrument, validated by its check digit.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last day of the reporting period the document states it covers.

fields.name: trustee_report
fields.description: Id of the trustee's breach report, a document in `documents.csv`.

fields.name: field
fields.description: Kind of information: clause reference, obligation wording, required level, issuer's measured level, deed dates.

fields.name: issuer_prints
fields.description: Whether any of the statement's exception lines for the ISIN prints it.

fields.name: trustee_prints
fields.description: Whether any of the trustee's report items for the ISIN, or for deed dates its letters for the quarter, prints it. The issuer's measured level counts only if the trustee prints the same number and unit.

fields.name: issuer_examined
fields.description: How many of the statement's exception lines for the ISIN were examined.

fields.name: issuer_evidence
fields.description: JSON list of every exception line that satisfied the rule: document, page, locator and the text that matched.
fields.brdo:rights: The pointers are the project's; each `matched` text is a short quotation from the source, not licensed.
fields.brdo:empty: no line satisfied the rule; `issuer_examined` says how many were looked at

fields.name: trustee_examined
fields.description: How many report items, or for deed dates letters for the quarter, were examined.

fields.name: trustee_evidence
fields.description: JSON list of every report item or letter that satisfied the rule: document, page, locator and the text that matched.
fields.brdo:rights: The pointers are the project's; each `matched` text is a short quotation from the source, not licensed.
fields.brdo:empty: nothing satisfied the rule; `trustee_examined` says how many were looked at, and 0 means the record holds nothing to examine, not that the trustee printed nothing

fields.name: ai_training_reserved
fields.description: True when the row derives from a source that publishes a reservation against AI training. Exclude such rows from any training or benchmark use.

resources.name: follow-up-states
resources.description: For each ISIN listed in a current trustee report for a period, one row per follow-up state that the trustee's reports and letters publish, with where the record shows it and how its period is known. A listed ISIN with none has one row reading `no follow-up published`. Rows with no period come from letters that name no quarter and cannot be tied to one. States are never ranked or merged.

fields.name: trustee
fields.description: Id of the debenture trustee in `sources.csv`.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: ISIN of the instrument, validated by its check digit.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: The reporting period the state is counted for.
fields.brdo:empty: the letter names no quarter and the rule cannot tie it to one; counted for no period

fields.name: state
fields.description: The state, from the project's reading of action cells and letters. A cure is typed financial or other only when every covenant the row lists for the ISIN is of that kind; otherwise it is a cure for covenants of more than one kind.

fields.name: is_outcome
fields.description: True for the six outcome states: enforcement or nominee director, waiver, holders instructing no action, and the three kinds of cure.

fields.name: attribution
fields.description: How the period is known: `report_row` (a row of the period's report), `letter_period` (the quarter recorded for the letter), `linked_by_rule` (a letter naming no quarter, continuing a letter of the same file that names one) or `not_attributable`.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: The report row and action kinds, or the letter, that show the state, and for linked letters the rule.
fields.brdo:empty: no follow-up is published for the ISIN

resources.name: monitoring-censuses
resources.description: One row per trustee table of the issues it monitors (Annex-VIIA, Table 3), measured rather than republished. `brdo verify` recomputes every measure from the hashed file.

fields.name: id

fields.name: document

fields.name: trustee

fields.name: period_start
fields.description: First day of the reporting period the document states it covers.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last day of the reporting period the document states it covers.

fields.name: isins_printed
fields.description: Distinct ISINs printed in the file that pass the check digit.

fields.name: listed_in_breach_report
fields.description: ISINs the same trustee's breach report for the period lists.

fields.name: listed_not_printed
fields.description: Listed ISINs the census omits.

fields.name: sample
fields.description: ISINs outside the breach report whose SHA-256 of the file's hash, a colon and the ISIN sorts first.

fields.name: report_not_received

fields.name: rows_cited

fields.name: ai_training_reserved
fields.description: True when the row derives from a source that publishes a reservation against AI training. Exclude such rows from any training or benchmark use.
